channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.12'

about.description:
A tool based in Python to use Antechamber to generate topologies
for chemical compounds and to interface with other python
applications like CCPN or ARIA.

CHARMM output additionally needs `charmmgen`, which modern AmberTools no longer
ships. Run `acpype --fetch-charmmgen` once to install it into this environment.

name: acpype
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "acpype" %}
{% set version = "2026.9.4" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  # The PyPI sdist, not the GitHub archive: the tag tarball carries ~68 MB of vendored
  # AmberTools that this package must not ship, since it depends on conda-forge's.
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 1ae68578899879ad8cfd9e81fbc1be29692a0296ddd9cd62a34e8c6fbb27aec8

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  entry_points:
    - acpype = acpype.cli:init_main

requirements:
  host:
    # acpype builds with uv_build since 2026.9.2; poetry is gone.
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - uv-build >=0.9,<0.13
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - ambertools
    - openbabel
    - rich >=14.2.0
    - typer >=0.20.0

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - acpype
  commands:
    - acpype -h

about:
  home: https://github.com/alanwilter/acpype
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_family: GPL
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Generates topologies for chemical compounds
  description: |
    A tool based in Python to use Antechamber to generate topologies
    for chemical compounds and to interface with other python
    applications like CCPN or ARIA.

    CHARMM output additionally needs `charmmgen`, which modern AmberTools no longer
    ships. Run `acpype --fetch-charmmgen` once to install it into this environment.
  doc_url: https://github.com/alanwilter/acpype
  dev_url: https://github.com/alanwilter/acpype

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - alanwilter
    - lkagami
    - simonbray
